description: Port universe + inland yards for Ocean Network Express (ONE). Keys from one_yards.geojson (CityYard). type is port (v3 secondary-scrape target) or inland (v3 main scrape). v3 = scrape inland, derive ports, secondary-scrape missing ports (see /synth.md). READ-ONLY: v3 only reads type. ONE returns port names (podName) directly, so no location-code enrichment is needed. NOTE: yard set has only Los Angeles (no Long Beach) and Tacoma (no Seattle); utils.normalize_pod keeps Los Angeles/Long Beach and Seattle/Tacoma distinct, so any Long Beach/Seattle voyages appear only as derive-only distinct discharge ports (never queried), like HPL Long Beach. [v2 copy — independent from v3 coverage.json so the two workers never affect each others call set. 13 ports; co-located Long Beach/Seattle/Port Everglades are not queried separately (ONEs LA/Tacoma queries already return them).]
